description: Sends a business owner's finance enquiry to a licensed Switchboard Finance broker, who contacts them by phone, SMS and email. Requires consent: true, meaning the person has agreed to this wording: "I agree to Switchboard Finance contacting me about this enquiry by phone, SMS and email, including follow-up emails I can unsubscribe from at any time." Returns a reference number and the expected contact time. Nothing is applied for and no credit check is run. Retries with the same idempotency_key return the original reference instead of creating a second enquiry.

agent_name.description: Name of the assistant submitting, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude

business_purpose.description: True if the funds are for a business purpose

consent.description: True only if the person agreed to the consent wording in this tool's description

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key (8-128 chars) so a retry does not create a duplicate enquiry

notice_shown.description: True if the collection notice from check_fit (next_step.collection_notice) was shown to the person

scenario.description: The finance need in the owner's words: purpose, rough amount, timing

name: request_callback
title: Request a broker callback
